question: What is the meaning of life-cycle assessment (lca) in relation to certification and labeling?
description: Life-cycle assessment (LCA) in relation to certification and labeling involves the analytical methodology used to analyze and quantify the environmental aspects and impacts of product systems over their entire life cycle. This includes materials, products, processes, and buildings. LCA is utilized for various purposes such as product development, improvement, strategic planning, public policy making, marketing, and other applications. It involves assessing the environmental performance of products and processes based on standardized data compiled in formats like Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) and LCA databases.
